summary: xcselect returns the path to a macOS SDK on the host, for build tools that do not run through Xcode. It is a build-time helper for Apple's toolchain. BifrOSt has no macOS SDK and no Xcode toolchain to locate.

features.note: Returns a macOS SDK path. BifrOSt builds with Cargo and Linux toolchains, not macOS SDKs.

features.apple: Command Line Tools and Xcode selection (framework overview)
features.note: Selects the active Apple developer toolchain. Not applicable on Linux.

gaps: None for BifrOSt. Apps that need a toolchain path use Cargo and the Linux SDK, so there is no counterpart to add.
